meta.patch: 0.5.5 (content update 0.5.0 'Return of the Ancients'), league Forbidden Rites
sources: local RePoE cache: %APPDATA%/PoE 2 Price Checker/cache/repoe-mods.json, repoe-base-items.json
meta.classNote: Classes come from poe2db's per-class 'Class / Modifier / Pre/Suf / Required Level' table on each item page, so tooltip groups are already expanded there: 'Shield' -> Shields + Bucklers; 'Jewellery' -> Rings + Amulets; 'Mace' -> One Hand Maces + Two Hand Maces; 'Gloves or Boots' -> Gloves + Boots; 'Equipment' -> every weapon/armour/jewellery/quiver/shield/buckler/focus class (no Jewels). Classes outside the app list (Daggers, One/Two Hand Swords, One/Two Hand Axes, Flails) were dropped and named in each entry's notes. 'affix' and 'requiredLevel' are extra fields from poe2db (requiredLevel = mod level; 0 = none shown). Ranges are written (min-max).
meta.craftedNote: 0.5.0 patch notes: 'All crafted modifiers are now guaranteed, but items can only have 1 crafted modifier at a time.' and 'Desecrated modifiers no longer count as crafted modifiers, but items are limited to 1 Desecrated modifier.' Alloys are explicitly 'crafted modifiers'. Essence mods (incl. corrupted essences / Mark of the Abyssal Lord) count as crafted per player bug reports showing 'This item already has a crafted modifier' (forum 3960848).

unverified: Essence mods (incl. corrupted essences) counting as 'crafted': the official notes say so explicitly only for Alloys; for essences it rests on player bug reports (forum 3960848, 3956910) showing 'This item already has a crafted modifier'.
Whether applying a corrupted essence corrupts the target item: the item text does not mention corruption; assumed it does not, but no source says so outright.
Perfect Orb of Transmutation/Augmentation minimum modifier level 70 comes from the poe2db tooltip only; the 0.5.0 patch-note line found mentions only Greater (44, previously 55).
Adaptive Alloy: RePoE contains Cold/Lightning/Chaos 'ConvertedAlloy...' variants of the Fire 'while missing Runic Ward' mods; how they are obtained is unconfirmed.
RePoE HandWraps* alloy/essence mod variants (other texts, for a Hand Wraps glove sub-type) are not shown on poe2db pages; whether alloys/essences roll them on Hand Wraps is unconfirmed, omitted.
poe2db lists Daggers, One/Two Hand Swords, One/Two Hand Axes and Flails for several alloys and Essence of the Abyss; these are outside the app's class list and were omitted.
